module: "wayPointAction" scenario goal: displays an on-screen message when a vehicle reaches certain waypoints of the race. Loaded by scenario_raceGoals (init, processState, updateFinalStatus); declared in goals.vehicles with id 'wayPointAction'.
notes: On the 'onRaceWaypointReached' event (only if scenario.state == 'running' and raceState == 'racing'), compares vehWpData.cur (current waypoint index, via scenario_waypoints.getVehicleWaypointData) with each entry of value.wayPointNum and displays value.wayPointMsg[i] for 2 s (helper.flashUiMessage) at the matching index.
BUG/inconsistency: init sets value.wayPointMsg to the string " " if absent; indexing it like an array (wayPointMsg[i]) gives nil and the displayed message is empty/nil.
BUG/inconsistency: init does not check that wayPointNum exists; if it is nil, processState calls next(nil) and raises a Lua error.
BUG/inconsistency: if getVehicleWaypointData returns nil (vehicle without waypoint data), vehWpData.cur raises an error.

instances.desc: 'wayPointAction' goal instances for the current scenario, filled by init.

init.desc: Rebuilds M.instances from scenario.goals.vehicles (id == 'wayPointAction') after validating the type of wayPointNum (array).

processState.desc: Called by scenario_raceGoals; only reacts to 'onRaceWaypointReached' during the race and displays the message of the waypoint reached.

updateFinalStatus.desc: Called at the end of the scenario; does nothing.
